name: @xeonsky/picturex
description: PictureX —— 本地优先、支持 i18n 与运行时换肤的 AI 相册

scripts.postinstall: node scripts/task.mjs apps/web postinstall && node scripts/ensure-ffmpeg.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm check:tokens && pnpm check:i18n && pnpm check:hardcode && pnpm check:docs
scripts.lint: eslint packages/cli scripts && node scripts/task.mjs apps/web lint && node scripts/task.mjs apps/desktop lint
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/task.mjs apps/web typecheck && node scripts/task.mjs apps/desktop typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm bootstrap && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm build:npm && node scripts/task.mjs apps/desktop build
scripts.desktop:dist: pnpm desktop:build && node scripts/task.mjs apps/desktop dist:win
scripts.desktop:dist:linux: pnpm desktop:build && node scripts/task.mjs apps/desktop dist:linux
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: pnpm desktop:build && node scripts/task.mjs apps/desktop dist:mac
